title: `---` after a tab at the start of a line is a plain scalar, not a document start
notes: A document marker must be at the start of the line (production 206), so after a tab `--- b` is the plain scalar `--- b`. After the end marker a new bare document begins and the tab is separation in front of its scalar (production 66). The second document is the string `--- b`, not a document with the value `b`.

provenance.reference: A reader that skipped the tab before looking for a marker and started a second document with the value `b`.
